summary: Frontend testing completed for Interactive Hit-Rate Dropdown feature on Player Detail page. All core functionality verified with Kevin Durant's props.

prop_rows_clickable.details: Prop rows on Player Detail page are clickable and expand on click

l5_hit_rate_format.details: L5 shows 'X/Y = Z%' format (e.g., 4/5 = 80% for KD 19.5 Points)

l10_hit_rate_format.details: L10 shows 'X/Y = Z%' format (e.g., 8/10 = 80% for KD 19.5 Points)

season_hit_rate_format.details: Season shows 'X/Y = Z%' format (e.g., 51/65 = 78% for KD 19.5 Points)

season_average_comparison.details: Season Average displays with line comparison (e.g., 24.7 +5.2 above line)

chevron_rotation.details: Chevron icon rotates 180 degrees when expanded (rotate-180 class applied)

collapse_functionality.details: Clicking same row again collapses dropdown - toggle works correctly

color_coding.details: Green (>=70%), Yellow (50-69%), Orange (30-49%), Red (<30%) correctly applied

critical_code_review_comments: LadderPropRow component correctly implements useState for isExpanded toggle
Color helper getPctColor() properly returns Tailwind classes for percentage ranges
Hit rate data properly sourced from prop.hit_rates with L5, L10, season breakdowns
Season Average comparison correctly calculates difference from line value
